note: The figure record's contract, machine-readable (kogaki#878).
A figure record is the INSTANCE of a Move's `visual_form` in the sense a
Step is the instance of a Move: the form names roles and says nothing a
reader sees (src/figure-kinds.json), the Brief binds each role to one of
the Step's grounds (the figure decision), and this record is where
each bound ground is finally worded for the reader.
src/draft.mjs READS these lists rather than restating them, the same
arrangement src/recovered-schema.json has with src/review-draft.mjs: the
record's shape is amended in one place and never in two that agree until
one is edited.
THE ROLE SET IS NOT HERE, and that is deliberate. `elements` is keyed by
the roles of the record's own kind, which src/figure-kinds.json holds and
the Move's form selects. Copying a role set into this file would be a
second vocabulary that drifts from the closed one; the validator joins the
two files instead.
THE RECORD IS FILLED AFTER THE PROSE. That is the hub's third moment --
concrete design after the text -- and it is why `caption` is stated in the
Step's `reader_state_after` terms: the caption says what the reader holds
after looking, which is only answerable once what they have read exists.
NOTHING HERE JUDGES WORDING. Whether an element's text is a fair wording
of its ground, and whether the relations instantiate the kind's `relation`
line, are judgments -- the judgment rule: a missing field is refused and a
weak one is not. The mechanical half is: every role present, no extra
role, every element bound to the ground the BRIEF bound that role to, the
kind equal to the form's, and a position from the closed pair.
SPEC REFERENCES IN THIS FILE (kogaki#902, owner ruling 2026-09-05).
Implemented code does not refer to a Spec. Content this file was
implemented against is stated HERE, and what is stated here is what the
code was implemented against - NOT the spec's current text. It stays true
for this file even if the spec is rewritten or deleted, and propagating a
later spec change into this file is a SEPARATE, EXPLICIT act. A bare name
below is a pointer carrying no authority. Nothing names a section number,
because section numbers renumber.
THE NAMES THIS FILE USES, and the spec each one names:
the figure decision
SPEC-draft-pipeline
the judgment rule
SPEC-draft-pipeline

kind.why: the record's kind is the FORM's kind, not a choice made at realization -- a record that picked its own would be the realization re-opening a decision the Move library and the Brief already made

elements.keyed_by: the roles of this record's kind
elements.why: one element per role, each carrying the reader-facing wording and the ground address it was worded from -- the address is what lets a later reader, and kogaki#880's review, join an element back to what licensed it

relations.why_min: a figure asserting no relation between its elements is a list, and the kind's whole content is the relation it holds -- an empty array is a record that did not do the one thing the form asks for

emphasis.must_be: a role of this record's kind
emphasis.why: emphasis names WHICH element the figure leans on, so a value outside the role set points at nothing the renderer can mark

caption.why: the line rendered under the block, in the Step's `reader_state_after` terms -- what the reader holds after looking

position.why: the anchor is the Step, and within the Step a figure either sets the prose up or discharges it; a third value would be a placement the body assembly has no seat for
